review_notes: Reviewed the current top-level proposal.json in full, rather than treating the librarian packet in context as the submitted proposal. Also read all of functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json, and link-dispositions.json.

All four proposed writes concern owned subjects and are supported. They distinguish ItemKind selection from turnip variant selection, record unchecked selector boundaries without claiming compiled execution, replace the pending-event guarantee with exact local operations, and correct unconditional Wait completion.

Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered form; enumerated all 30 owned subjects, 81 baseline facts, and 35 outgoing links. Rendered substitutions were not used as independent semantic evidence.

Independently checked Peach's active motion table and aggregate cleanup caller; the turnip constructor, variant chooser, destruction notification and saved-owner invalidation; common throw entry and trajectory consumer; transition and event-consumption inlines; collision wrappers; animation predicate; physics wrappers; joint-position helper; attribute declarations; and RNG implementation.

The top-level review appropriately defers more than the librarian packet: pending-event preservation and three overstrong outgoing-link records remain unresolved. Acceptance does not establish those claims.

Inferred aliases are retained only as descriptive hypotheses. Their original-name and opcode-identity rationales are not independently proved. Likewise, retention of ordinary-data physics descriptions does not establish behavior for malformed attributes or arbitrary exceptional floats.
No replacement proposal, new relationship, entity, merge, or artifact mutation is supplied.
